node.statement: For fixed s,t in Sigma_j, define A_st exactly as in node 1.1.2 by A_st:=Phi_q(Delta_q(hat-U_js) Phi_q(Delta_q(Y)) Delta_q(hat-U_jt^*)). By node 1.1.1, Delta_q(I)=I and Phi_q,Delta_q are contractive. Applying lem-routef-degree-two-estimate at n=q with X=I and the present Y gives ||Phi_q(Delta_q(Y))-Delta_q(Y)||<=C_2*eta*||Y||. With D:=Phi_q(Delta_q(Y))-Delta_q(Y), linearity gives A_st-Phi_q(Delta_q(hat-U_js)Delta_q(Y)Delta_q(hat-U_jt^*))=Phi_q(Delta_q(hat-U_js) D Delta_q(hat-U_jt^*)). Hence contractivity and ||hat-U_js||=||hat-U_jt^*||=1 imply the asserted bound <=C_2*eta*||Y||.
